ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel base (dark gray to black) with high-intensity linear and punctate disruptions (white/light gray) creating localized high-contrast regions against the dark background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity linear pixel strings are distributed globally across both lobes. Punctate high-intensity clusters are concentrated along the distal tips and the upper margins of the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior angle and high relative depth extending toward the insertion point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged profile with high-frequency variations. Notable macro-serrations (distinct peaks) located on the distal half of the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-concave curve originating from the median notch and extending upward to sharp distal vertices on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white) localized primarily on the upper quadrant of the right lobe and scattered along the dorsal-facing edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of multi-directional, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (scratches) covering the majority of the visible ventral surface area on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive network of overlapping linear rake marks and punctate scars distributed across the entire visible surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical grouping of parallel linear scars on the medial-proximal region of the right lobe.
